name: Bridge Creek
gaugeName: BRIDGE CREEK @ COUNTY TRUNK HIGHWY V NR AUGUSTA,WI
blurb: Bridge Creek in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: The DNR-listed Dells Mill Pond carry-in is on the impoundment above Dells Mill Dam. A usable authorized carry to downstream Bridge Creek has not been established. The separate Highway V bridge launch described by paddlers is not this pond landing and must not be substituted without permission and a new access review.
sections.routeReview: This pond-to-Harstad itinerary encounters the Dells Mill dam site. A downstream bridge approach is a different access with steep banks and unresolved permission; no continuous float, safe passage or legal portage is approved.

notices.title: Pond landing is above the dam
notices.text: The DNR lake survey maps Dells Millpond and its dam separately from downstream Bridge Creek. The public pond carry-in does not establish a downstream bridge launch or an authorized carry around the mill. This itinerary remains withheld.
notices.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — Dells Millpond lake survey and public carry-in record 5083
